priority_scale.must: MVP (course pilot) requirement from PRD §7.1–7.19; done only when every listed acceptance criterion passes in the demo environment (PRD §13).
priority_scale.should: Phase 2 backlog item from PRD §7.20; needs acceptance criteria before it enters a build plan.
priority_scale.excluded: Phase 3 items (Could) and non-goals are not included.

features.description: Sign up / log in with email + password or Google. Email magic-link login is offered as an alternative to a password.

features.description: Acceptance re-validates availability atomically (FR-M6-07); on conflict, acceptance fails and both parties are told.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given two acceptance requests for the same dates within milliseconds, then exactly one booking hold exists and the other request gets a conflict error.

features.description: Backup quote: a quote whose dates overlap another organizer's tentative or booking hold is sent as a backup quote labeled "Tanggal sedang ditahan" ("Dates currently on hold"); Accept is disabled while the hold exists. When the hold is released or lapses, every backup-quote holder for those dates is notified at the same time, Accept is enabled, the first acceptance wins atomically, and each backup quote's validity is extended to at least 2 business days after the release. When the hold becomes a confirmed booking, backup quotes expire with reason "Tanggal sudah dipesan" ("Dates booked"). A quote can't be sent at all for dates that are already Booked or Blocked.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given Rina's booking hold on 12–14 Dec, when the venue quotes Sari for 13 Dec, then Sari's quote is labeled "Tanggal sedang ditahan" with Accept disabled; when Rina's booking is confirmed, then Sari's quote expires with reason "Tanggal sudah dipesan".

Given two backup quotes and the blocking booking lapses, then both holders are notified together, the first to accept gets the booking hold, the other sees a conflict, and a backup quote whose validity would have ended is extended to at least 2 business days after the release.

features.description: Pilot notice accepted at sign-up and at registration: who runs the pilot (Group4), its purpose, the data collected, the hosting provider and country where data is stored, that bookings are practice runs with no real payment, the deletion date, and a contact email. Acceptance is recorded per user with the notice version.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a new user, then sign-up shows the pilot notice with the hosting provider and storage country, deletion date and practice-booking statement, and records acceptance with its version; users must confirm they are 18 or older.

features.description: Data rule: Spot-In has no field for, and must not collect, ID documents or photos of them, selfies, NIK, NPWP, NIB, deeds, bank account or card numbers. Phones are optional contact fields only. A pre-demo script scans the database for the blocked field types and 16-digit NIK-like or card-like numbers and reports any match.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the database schema, then no column exists for ID documents, NIK, NPWP, NIB, bank or card numbers; the pre-demo scan reports zero matches on seed and pilot data.

features.description: Data lifecycle: every user can download their data (JSON) and delete their account in settings; on the pilot deletion date the Admin runs a documented job that deletes or anonymizes all pilot users' personal data and files.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a user, then they can download their data as JSON and delete their account; the documented deletion job, run on a copy of pilot data, leaves no personal fields.

features.description: Production database and file storage access is limited to named team members; each access is logged; seed and test data never mix with pilot users' data (separate environments).

acceptance_criteria.text: Given production access, then only named team members have credentials, each access is logged, and seed data lives in a separate environment.

features.description: Payments use test mode only; starting the server with live payment keys while pilot mode is on fails (FR-M14-13).

acceptance_criteria.text: Given live payment keys in the configuration with pilot mode on, then the server refuses to start; with no test-mode access configured, the simulator produces pending, paid, expired and failed states through the same adapter interface.

features.description: Venue penalties, ranking effects and any money-related consequences outside the ledger are off.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a venue cancellation, then the organizer is refunded everything paid including the Spot-In fee, no penalty is recorded, and the cancellation is Owner-only.
